evidence.description: Detection model scored the $1,000.03 online transaction 3506725 at 0.90
Transaction originated from a device never previously associated with card C10434-K1
Device profile shares a proxy/IP signature with a device linked to a confirmed fraud case in closed_cases_history
Similar new-device CNP pattern confirmed as fraud on a different customer's card in the same week

case.reasoning: The transaction amount and new-device signal alone (risk_score 0.90) are a single signal under policy R1, so step-up authentication was requested first. The device's shared proxy signature with a confirmed prior fraud case raised confidence to 0.93, past the threshold for a defensible block. Exposure of $1,000.03 exceeds the $1,000 SAR threshold under policy 3a.

sar.reason: Confirmed fraud with exposure exceeding $1,000 and a shared device-profile link to a prior confirmed case (policy 3a)
sar.summary: Card-not-present fraud from a new device on card C10434-K1: a $1,000.03 online transaction (3506725) matched a device profile linked to a previously confirmed fraud case. Card blocked; case opened; report filed per policy R2/3a.

initial.justification: Policy R1: the risk score is a single signal; require step-up authentication before any block decision.

final.justification: Step-up authentication failed and the new-device signal matched a confirmed prior fraud case. Policy R2: block and create a case; exposure ($1,000.03) is ≤ $2,500 so this routes to L1. FILE_REPORT and CREATE_CASE are also recommended alongside this action per policy 3a (exposure exceeds $1,000).

evidence_requests: Step-up authentication result for card C10434-K1
stop_reason: Step-up failure plus a confirmed-case device match provide sufficient, defensible evidence for a block, case and report; no further evidence needed.
